events.title: 0.3.0 Update: All-New Visuals, Replays, a Timing Editor & osu! Import
events.summary: All-New VisualsReworked Gameplay Visuals: New particles and VFX, a music-reactive background, and a new HUD that sits neatly around the keyboard.Fresh UI Look: A new design with a yellow accent color and sharper text everywhere.Replays & ScoresWatch Replays: Watch any leaderboard score as a replay.Score Details & Profiles: View score details, and other players' profiles.Editor UpgradesNew Timing Tab: Tempo changes, automatic BPM detection, a metronome, and a zoomable waveform with beat snapping.

events.title: 0.2.0 Major Update: Community Level Browser, Leaderboards & Much More
events.summary: User Profiles, Leaderboards & RankingsNew Player Profiles: Track your overall progression with dedicated stats, including total score, ranked score, and accuracy.Leveling & XP System: Earn XP by playing maps and level up your profile over time.Custom Map Leaderboards: Leaderboards are no longer restricted to official levels. Custom community levels now have full leaderboard support!Infinite Scroll Leaderboards: Removed the strict 10-score limit. Leaderboards now dynamically load more scores as y

events.title: Thank you for 2.000 wishlists!
events.summary: 2000 wishlists already?!Thanks to ALL of you for wishlisting the game, playing the demo, and giving me feedback over on Discord! 💜I'm working super hard on getting out the next updates with custom key layouts / game modes and I'm looking forward to seeing how you will be using these new tools. 😄I'm also working on a MUPO server that will handle level publishing, replays and much more, so stay tuned. 🙂If you haven't already go wishlist MUPO now

events.title: Dev-Log: Demo Release & Feedback
events.summary: These last few weeks were pretty stressful but also exciting.The playable demo is finally out on Steam. I've added a new tutorial level, in-game accuracy display, visual health bar, leaderboard friends tab, audio latency setting, and a Discord rich presence integration. I've also made sure that your global scores will carry over when I change the leaderboards from Steam to a custom Supabase server in the future.It's my first time releasing something on Steam and I'm really thankful for everyone
